svg.title: Ansible Vault decryption workflow with age and SSH keys
svg.desc: Ansible reads the encrypted vaults and calls vault_wrapper-client.sh with the vault ID. The wrapper sends the matching encrypted .age master password file to age. age decrypts it with the SSH private key that ssh_key_cache.py reads from the kernel keyring. The cleartext password flows back to the wrapper and then to Ansible. The SSH key is stored in the keyring once, after entering its passphrase.
